name: Ground Zero
size: Small downtown block, dense interiors plus an underground parking level (~0.16 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: No fixed Scav boss below level 21
bosses.threat: Deliberate — this is the tutorial map and the sub-21 pool has no boss at all.

bosses.name: Cultists
bosses.threat: Eight mapped spawn points of silent poison-knife rushers. The main reason the 21+ pool feels like a different map.

bosses.name: Black Division
bosses.chance: Season 1 · RARELY encountered roaming (level 21+ pool only)
bosses.threat: Geared seasonal squad. The single biggest jump in danger when you cross level 21. Note the wiki qualifies this as a rare roaming spawn, not a standing presence — do not plan a raid around meeting them.

loot.name: TerraGroup HQ
loot.yield: The centre of gravity: PC blocks, drawers, intel and tech, with GPU and sealed-crate spawns at 21+. Office 4 on the 2nd floor is the Science Office — 3 PC blocks and 4 drawers

loot.name: Underground parking — Utility Room
loot.yield: Best guns-and-ammo room here: dead Scav, wooden ammo box, toolbox, grenade box, 4×4 and 5×2 weapon boxes

loot.name: Unity Credit Bank / Tarbank
loot.yield: Cash registers and loose currency; customer desk booth 2 has a locked safe and a drawer

loot.name: Nakatani building and basement
loot.yield: Residential safes, drawers, meds and quest items — and it sits on a free extract, making it the safest loot-then-leave loop on the map

keys.name: Underground parking utility room key
keys.opens: The garage utility room — weapon, ammo, grenade and tool boxes

keys.name: TerraGroup science office key
keys.opens: Office 4, 2nd floor of the main building — 3 PC blocks, 4 drawers

keys.name: Unity Credit Bank cash register key
keys.opens: Tarbank booth 2 — currency, a locked safe and a drawer

keys.name: Note with code word "Adaptation"
keys.opens: Activates the Tartowers Sales Office extract. In-raid intel, cannot be taken out

tip: Ground Zero is a street map that plays like an indoor map — fights happen in doorways, lobbies and stairwells, not on the road — so route through the TerraGroup and Nakatani interiors and treat every street crossing as a peek. Use your sub-21 raids to memorise Emercom Checkpoint and Nakatani Basement Stairs cold, because at 21+ the same geometry comes with roaming Cultists, Black Division and much better-shooting Scavs. Don't chase an extract along the map perimeter — claymores, minefields and border snipers ring the edges — and don't stand in the open firing the Mira Ave flare; grab it off the Scav body by the yellow bus and shoot from cover.
notes: Matchmaking splits at level 21: a beginners pool below 21 and an experienced pool at 21+, so there is effectively a separate 21+ version. Groups match on their highest-level member. The 21+ pool has better rare-loot chance, harder Scavs, Cultists and Season 1 Black Division. One of only two maps directly selectable on a fresh account.

name: Interchange
size: One huge dark indoor mall plus ring road and parking decks (~0.4 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Killa
bosses.chance: Guaranteed on red-skull cycle · ~50–60% otherwise, the highest baseline in the game
bosses.threat: Armoured RPK-16 juggernaut who pushes toward gunfire down the ground-floor aisles and eats unarmoured ammo.

bosses.name: Tagilla
bosses.threat: New to the parking garage under Goshan. Melee only, but lethal in the garage's blind corners.

loot.name: OLI hardware store
loot.yield: Best PC-block and GPU density on the map, plus tools, electric motors, fuel, building materials and 18 cash registers. A Bitcoin spawns mid-store inside the sandbags

loot.name: Techlight / Texho / Rasmussen shelves
loot.yield: The classic tech run — loose GPUs and electronics, with a LEDX in the broken box under Techlight

loot.name: KIBA Arms outlet
loot.yield: Weapons, mods, armour plates, 3 weapon boxes, 2 locked registers. Needs both Kiba keys AND mall power, and trips an alarm 3 seconds after the outer door opens

loot.name: NecrusPharm, ULTRA medical storage and EMERCOM medical unit
loot.yield: LEDX, meds, stims and Medbag SMU06s. ULTRA med needs power; EMERCOM's three doors each burn a key use

keys.name: Kiba Arms outer door key + inner grate key
keys.opens: The KIBA firearms store — needs the pair plus power. Three weapon boxes, mods, armour plates, ammo

keys.name: Object #11SR keycard
keys.opens: The Saferoom in parking section C — modded M4s, 3 weapon boxes, Bitcoin. Also a private single-use extract that locks behind you. Power required

keys.name: Object #21WS keycard
keys.opens: The red TerraGroup container in the outdoor lot — 3 weapon boxes, SIG MPX, HighCom armour. Power required

keys.name: ULTRA medical storage key
keys.opens: The 2nd-floor pharmacy storage room — LEDX and meds. Max 5 per raid, power required

keys.name: Goshan / OLI / IDEA cash register keys
keys.opens: Roughly 30 Goshan, 18 OLI and 20 IDEA registers — the IDEA key also covers NecrusPharm. Bulk rouble farming

tip: Spawns ring the mall — highway, the west village and FOB, and the power-station side — so the first 90 seconds is a race to the nearest service or side entrance, never the big glass fronts. The interior is pitch black even at midday, so most deaths are being silhouetted in a doorway or lit up down the long IDEA and Goshan aisles. If you hear a hammer that's Tagilla in the parking garage; an RPK-16 is Killa on the central ground floor — change floors either way. Don't flip the power station switch unless you are actually running Kiba, #11SR, #21WS or ULTRA med: it lights the whole grid and tells fourteen players someone is working the mall.
notes: One of only two maps directly selectable on a fresh account — everything else is initially transit-only until the story chapter 'Tour'.

name: Woods
size: Very large open forest with big elevation change (~1.6 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Shturman + 2–3 guards
bosses.threat: Sawmill sniper king — his guards run SVDS and hit you past 150 m before you ever see the yard.

bosses.name: The Goons (Knight, Big Pipe, Birdeye)
bosses.chance: ~20–26%, rotating between Customs, Woods, Shoreline and Lighthouse
bosses.threat: Camp the northwest antenna and Scav Bunker, holding high ground and cross-firing the approach.

bosses.name: Partisan
bosses.threat: Mines paths and ambushes lone loot runs with a suppressed AK.

bosses.name: Cultists
bosses.threat: Silent poison knives, and the treeline hides them completely.

loot.name: Sawmill + Shturman's common fund stash
loot.yield: Fastest money here: cash, valuables, electronics, electronic keys, magazines and ammo packs. Boss kit is SVDS and Red Rebel tier

loot.name: Old house at the Old Railway Depot
loot.yield: Hideout gold behind two cheap keys: 6-STEN-140-M batteries with one guaranteed, military power filters, TerraGroup Blue Folders, a TarCoin, 4×4 weapon boxes

loot.name: Shatun's hideout, eastern village
loot.yield: A TerraGroup Labs Yellow keycard spawn plus rare rifles (M1A, RSASS), Slick carriers and premium headsets

loot.name: USEC camp
loot.yield: Low-risk fill: meds, rations, duffles, ammo boxes. One of three Violet keycard spawns sits on an SUV seat nearby

keys.name: Shturman's stash key
keys.opens: The common fund stash on a tyre by the log pile at Sawmill. Drops from Shturman, 1–2 uses

keys.name: Old house room key + toilet key
keys.opens: The depot house pair — batteries, power filters, Blue Folders, TarCoin. Cheap and repeatable

keys.name: Shatun's hideout key
keys.opens: The eastern village house with the Yellow keycard spawn

keys.name: ZB-014 key
keys.opens: The grate door inside ZB-014 (5×5 weapon box) and the ZB-014 flare extract

keys.name: Minefield map (Woods)
keys.opens: Activates the Railway Bridge to Tarkov extract. In-raid intel, cannot be taken out

tip: Woods is a sound-and-sightline map and the first ten minutes belong to whoever takes the ridge north of Sawmill. Shturman's guards run SVDS and reach past 150 m, so pull the boss from the log piles at the fence line rather than walking through the yard gate. The consistent death spots are the open field between USEC camp and Sawmill, anywhere on the road — BTR, snipers and mines — and the Outskirts funnel in the last five minutes. Don't hug the west or southwest map edge: minefields and border snipers kill more new players here than PMCs do.

name: Customs
size: Medium industrial corridor, long east–west (~0.6 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Reshala + 4 guards
bosses.threat: Dorms, New Gas and Scav-base warlord whose four guards are the actual danger — they flank and out-armour you while he tanks.

bosses.name: The Goons (Knight, Big Pipe, Birdeye)
bosses.threat: Roaming death squad at the Scav base and ZB-013. Birdeye headshots at range while Big Pipe walls you off with 40 mm.

bosses.name: Partisan
bosses.threat: Lone stalker who mines paths and ambushes with a suppressed AK. Kills you while you're looting, not while you're fighting.

bosses.name: Cultists
bosses.threat: Silent knife-rushers with poison blades, nearly invisible in the dark.

loot.name: Three-storey Dorms — marked room 314
loot.yield: The jackpot keyed room: rare valuables, Labs keycards, cases and containers, currency, high-tier weapons

loot.name: Two-storey Dorms — guard desk, 1st floor
loot.yield: The key farm. Spawns the 314 marked key, Tarcone office key, trailer-park key and dorm keys 104, 105, 108, 118, 204, 218, 303, 308 and 315, plus a weapon rack and ammo boxes

loot.name: Big Red warehouse — Tarcone Director's Office
loot.yield: Tech and intel: 3 PC blocks, a safe, sport bag, intelligence folder, plus backpack and armour spawns

loot.name: New Gas Station — office and storage room
loot.yield: Safe, pistol, ammo packs, 4×4 weapon box, medbag and medcase. Also a Reshala spawn

loot.name: Warehouse 6 — USEC stash
loot.yield: Two 4×4 weapon boxes and rare Western rifles: AUG, SR-25, M16, G36, SCAR-L

keys.name: Dorm room 314 marked key
keys.opens: The marked room on the 3rd floor of three-storey dorms. Highest expected value on the map and very fragile

keys.name: Dorm guard desk key
keys.opens: The 1st-floor key-farm room in two-storey dorms

keys.name: Tarcone Director's office key
keys.opens: The office at the top of the stairs in Big Red

keys.name: Factory emergency exit key
keys.opens: Both doors of the crane-yard guard building by New Gas — and on Factory, the Cellars and Med Tent Gate extracts

keys.name: Dorm room 110 and 114 keys
keys.opens: A cheap two-storey pair: safe, intel folder, secure flash drive, medcase, PC block

tip: Your spawn decides the raid. East spawns at Trailer Park and the bus depot must commit to Dorms inside three minutes or lose it; west spawns should loot the warehouses and arrive at Dorms around minute eight to twelve to clean up survivors. The reliable death spots are the open ground between New Gas and three-storey, both dorm stairwells — everyone pre-fires the landings — and the tarmac at Crossroads, so cross on the rail berm or treeline instead. Don't sprint the road straight into three-storey on an east spawn, and never loot 314 with your back to the door.
notes: Roughly 60 trader tasks reference Customs, about 34 of them Customs-only — the heaviest early-game funnel in the game.

name: Shoreline
size: Very large: beach, fields, village and the Azure Coast resort (~2.0 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Sanitar + 3 guards
bosses.threat: Resort and pier doctor who heals himself mid-fight and pushes with stims while his guards pin you in corridors.

bosses.name: The Goons (Knight, Big Pipe, Birdeye)
bosses.threat: Hold the weather station on the southeast hill and dominate the whole open approach.

bosses.name: Partisan
bosses.threat: Mines the resort approaches and ambushes loot runs.

bosses.name: Black Division
bosses.threat: Kitted seasonal squad with SR-25 and M60E6-class weapons. Fights like a geared player squad, not like Scavs. Note the wiki qualifies this as a rare roaming spawn, not a standing presence — do not plan a raid around meeting them.

bosses.name: Cultists
bosses.threat: Silent poison knives in the treelines and cottages.

loot.name: Health Resort west wing, 3rd floor (W301 → W304)
loot.yield: Best roubles-per-second on the map: LEDX, 2 GPUs, 5×5 weapon box, 2 PCs, SV-98. W311 is now permanently unlocked and holds a LEDX

loot.name: Health Resort east wing (E222 → E226, E110, E328)
loot.yield: Physical Bitcoin, RSASS, SV-98, MP5, 6×3 weapon box. E110 is Sanitar's office with multiple LEDX, a GPU and a PC

loot.name: HEP station — Voron's hideout and storage room
loot.yield: A Violet Labs keycard spawn, LEDX, ophthalmoscope, GPU and sports bags. The USEC stash adds 3 weapon boxes and an intel folder

loot.name: Cottages, weather station and Admin building
loot.yield: A Yellow Labs keycard spawn, 2 safes, 2 gun cabinets, a weather-station server-bay GPU, plus Admin desk GPUs and a cafeteria-cart LEDX

keys.name: Health Resort office key with a blue tape
keys.opens: East wing room 110, Sanitar's office — multiple LEDX in the bathroom, GPU, suitcase, PC

keys.name: West wing room 301 key
keys.opens: W301 (LEDX + GPU) and the balcony route into W304 — multiple LEDX, 2 GPUs, 5×5 box, 2 PCs

keys.name: East wing room 222 key
keys.opens: E222 (Bitcoin, RSASS, SV-98, MP5, 6×3 box) and the balcony into E226 for multiple LEDX

keys.name: Universal utility room key
keys.opens: Every resort utility room, plus a second route into E328

keys.name: Knossos LLC facility key
keys.opens: The west-wing basement door to the Labyrinth transit — the only way in

tip: The resort is the map's gravity well: spawns sit on the ring road and everyone funnels in, so the reliable killzones are the front courtyard, the fountain approach, and anybody standing on a 3rd-floor balcony. Chain rooms via the balconies rather than the corridors — W301→304, E222→226, E306→308 — and stop buying keys that 1.x made worthless: E108, E209, E213, E216, E322, W207, W303, W309, W323, W325 and the gas station and weather station safes are now permanently unlocked. Don't drift toward the Port Terminal gate without an access item; the RUAF gunners are neutral until you close distance, then they erase you.
notes: Shoreline is the transit hub for two other locations: the west-wing basement leads to The Labyrinth, and the pier leads to Icebreaker.

name: Factory
size: Very small multi-level indoor CQB with a tunnel network (~0.13 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Tagilla
bosses.threat: Hammer-swinging melee bruiser in a welding mask. He sprints at sound and one-shots through the chest in these corridors.

bosses.name: Cultists
bosses.threat: Silent poison-knife rushers, brutal in the dark tunnels.

loot.name: TerraGroup storage room, underground by the Camera Bunker Door
loot.yield: Keycard-locked jackpot: 2 TerraGroup safes, weapon locker, medbag, toolbox, possible LEDX and Physical Bitcoin

loot.name: Office block, 2nd and 3rd floors
loot.yield: Filing cabinets, weapon boxes, medbags and tech. The 3rd-floor locked room holds early quest items. This is the map's control point

loot.name: Locker room, 2nd floor off the main hall
loot.yield: Jackets and several weapon boxes, plus a back route onto the Courtyard Gate extract

loot.name: Main hall forklift crates and med-tent side
loot.yield: Loose weapon boxes, meds and provisions, with armour spawns nearby

keys.name: Factory emergency exit key
keys.opens: Near-mandatory: the Cellars extract, the Med Tent Gate extract, and the 3rd-floor office locked room. Max 5 per raid

keys.name: TerraGroup storage room keycard
keys.opens: The underground TerraGroup storage room. Drops from Cultists only, so it's a night-raid pursuit

keys.name: Note with code word "Ark"
keys.opens: Activates the Smugglers' Passage extract. Found in raid, cannot be taken out

tip: Read your spawn in the first two seconds and move — several spawns sit within ten seconds of two others, and the forklift-area spawns are the worst. Veterans play the vertical: own the 2nd and 3rd floor office catwalks and stairwell landings rather than the main hall floor, pre-nade blind corners, and use the tunnels only to reposition. Don't stand on Gate 3 running down the extract timer, it's the single most camped spot in the game, and don't reload in the open — on Factory somebody always hears it.
notes: Rated harder than its size suggests. It is superb for weapon-specific kill tasks because contact is guaranteed and a mistake only costs you twenty minutes — but it is not a beginner map.

name: Reserve
size: Medium-small but very dense, with a large underground bunker network (~0.4 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Glukhar + 6 guards
bosses.threat: The heaviest boss group in the game — seven bodies with ASh-12s sweeping the storage buildings and barracks as a coordinated squad.

bosses.name: Scav Raiders
bosses.chance: Always present; extra waves are event-triggered
bosses.threat: Elite AI that pushes with grenades and 7.62. The D-2 lever, the hermetic door lever and the armoured train all spawn them at you.

loot.name: The three marked rooms — RB-VO, RB-BK, RB-PKPM
loot.yield: Rare valuables, weapons, containers, cash, and a primary source of TerraGroup Labs keycards plus the Black, #11SR and #21WS cards. Bitcoin and GPUs in RB-VO

loot.name: The four underground caged supply areas (RB-PSP1/PSP2/PSV1/PSV2)
loot.yield: Bulk medical, ration and technical supply crates — the cheapest keys for the volume of hideout and barter loot

loot.name: RB-ST repair warehouse
loot.yield: Best military-tech room: TP-200 TNT brick, military gyrotachometer, 2 phased array elements, 2 6-STEN batteries, 3 OFZ shells, 3 weapon boxes

loot.name: RB-AK — Black Bishop school building, 2nd floor west staircase
loot.yield: Virtex processors, phased array elements, Tetriz, Golden 1GPhone, GPUs, 2 PC blocks. Pair it with the D-2 command bunker and the King and Queen server racks

keys.name: RB-VO marked key
keys.opens: The marked room in the security barracks — rare valuables, keycards, Bitcoin, GPU. Max 5 per raid

keys.name: RB-BK marked key
keys.opens: The marked room in Black Pawn barracks, 1st floor — same marked-room table

keys.name: RB-PKPM marked key
keys.opens: The marked room next to the underground command office, on the natural D-2 route

keys.name: RB-PSP2 key, then PSP1 / PSV1 / PSV2
keys.opens: The caged supply areas in the underground storage bunkers

keys.name: RB-ST key
keys.opens: The repair warehouse — TNT brick, gyrotachometer, phased arrays, batteries, OFZ shells

tip: Spawns are the tightest in Tarkov — several put you inside 100 m of another PMC — so identify your spawn by the nearest chess-marked building and hold an angle for thirty seconds instead of sprinting the open middle courtyard. The three marked rooms and the D-2 power lever are the map's standing ambush spots, and Reserve spawns Raiders at you: the D-2 lever spawns them in the bunker command section, the hermetic door lever spawns them at the train yard behind a four-minute siren. Don't extract on the armoured train unless you're already holding the doorway — it honks twice on arrival, sits exactly seven minutes, and by then every survivor is walking to it.
notes: Reserve's difficulty is the exit, not the loot: most extracts need an item, a condition or another player's cooperation. Decide your way out before you spawn.

name: Lighthouse
size: Large, long north–south coastal strip with heavy elevation (~1.7 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Rogues (USEC faction)
bosses.chance: Always — they garrison the water treatment plant
bosses.threat: Scripted base with NSV Utyos and AGS-30 emplacements and patrols that suppress you at range. Right now they only warn USEC players and shoot BEAR on sight.

bosses.name: Zryachiy + snipers
bosses.chance: Always, on the Lightkeeper peninsula bridge
bosses.threat: Sniper guarding the claymore-lined bridge. You need an encoded DSP radio transmitter to pass, and harming him decodes it.

bosses.name: The Goons (Knight, Big Pipe, Birdeye)
bosses.threat: Spawn at the water treatment plant or the blue chalet and cross-fire the exposed middle of the map.

bosses.name: Partisan
bosses.threat: Mines the main road and picks off runners.

loot.name: Water Treatment Plant — the Rogue base, north
loot.yield: The payday: the Operating room at LEDX and ophthalmoscope tier, the WTP storage room with military crates and weapon boxes, and the Rogue USEC barracks. Rogue corpses drop class 5–6 armour, M4 and HK416 platforms, high-pen ammo and NVGs

loot.name: The chalets and USEC cottages, mid-map
loot.yield: Two keyed cottage safes, jackets, PC blocks, wallets and weapon crates. Also a Goons spawn at the blue chalet

loot.name: Village and Hillside house, south
loot.yield: Loose loot, jackets and safes — cheap and quiet, close to the southern spawns and extracts

loot.name: Lighthouse peninsula
loot.yield: Best per-slot loot on the map — radar station, guard building and a shared-bedroom marked room — but gated behind an encoded DSP transmitter and Zryachiy

keys.name: Water treatment plant storage room key
keys.opens: Building 2, 1st floor southeast corner — military crates and a weapon box

keys.name: Operating room key
keys.opens: Building 1, ground floor northeast corner — the medical room

keys.name: Rogue USEC barrack key
keys.opens: Building 3, 1st floor southwest corner — gear and weapons

keys.name: USEC cottage room key, plus first and second safe keys
keys.opens: The chalet interior and its two safes

keys.name: Hillside house key
keys.opens: The south village house

tip: Your first Lighthouse deaths are the Rogue Utyos and AGS off the water-treatment catwalks, or a claymore on the peninsula bridge — so treat the north half as no-go until you have a break-line-of-sight plan. Southern spawns cluster around the village and southern road, and the customary early fight is over the chalets: commit or hard-avoid the middle for five minutes. Night raids blind the Rogue snipers and are the cheap way to learn the map. Don't hug the waterline to skip the road, because minefields and border snipers cover it, and never fire near the peninsula unless your DSP transmitter is already encoded.
upcoming: Patch 1.1.5.0 (September 2026) reworks Lighthouse and is NOT live yet: the Rogue base moves from the water treatment plant to the chalet area, landmines are removed except at the playable-area and Lightkeeper-peninsula boundaries, Lighthouse becomes the third BTR route along the main road through the village and water treatment plant, Rogues will shoot USEC on sight so the USEC free pass is gone, a UN checkpoint is added as cover on the central main road, and new Rogue caches, outposts and observation posts plus an underground cliff route appear. The Lightkeeper task chain is reworked too. Everything above describes the map as it is now.

name: Streets of Tarkov
size: Large, dense vertical urban core — the most complex geometry in the game (~1.2 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Kaban + 2 bodyguards, 4 guards and 2–3 snipers
bosses.threat: Holds the LexOs dealership with the largest entourage in the game. His snipers pin you while the guards close, and the dealership is claymored.

bosses.name: Kollontay + 4 guards
bosses.threat: Melee-focused ex-police boss at Klimov mall and the ministry, with a police baton and heavy armour.

bosses.name: Black Division
bosses.threat: Geared seasonal squad that fights like a player team — on top of the two bosses. Note the wiki qualifies this as a rare roaming spawn, not a standing presence — do not plan a raid around meeting them.

loot.name: Chekannaya 13 marked room
loot.yield: Marked-room table: LEDX, GPUs, keycards, moonshine, rare barter and high-tier weapons

loot.name: Abandoned factory marked room, 3rd floor of the northern factory
loot.yield: The map's second marked-room table

loot.name: LexOs car dealership — closed section and director's office
loot.yield: GPUs, cash, tech and high-tier weapons. Kaban drops PKM, PKP or RPK-16

loot.name: Concordia apartment complex
loot.yield: The security room is 2 PC blocks plus a safe — the fastest value on the map — plus keyed apartments 8, 34, 63 and 64, and a LEDX behind the east-side counter

loot.name: Tarbank and Klimov mall
loot.yield: Cash registers and safes. The Klimov toy-store whale slide holds a LEDX, and 1.1.0 added new loot points at the school, Rus Post office, Klimov mall and Cardinal apartments

keys.name: Mysterious room marked key
keys.opens: The marked room at house 13 Chekannaya Street

keys.name: Abandoned factory marked key
keys.opens: The 3rd-floor marked room in the northern abandoned factory

keys.name: Concordia security room key
keys.opens: 2 PC blocks and a safe — the best time-to-value room on the map

keys.name: Car dealership closed section key + director's office key
keys.opens: Kaban's stash area at LexOs

keys.name: Pinewood hotel room 215 key
keys.opens: A quest room on the natural north-side rotation

tip: Streets decides itself in the first 90 seconds — spawns are tight and paired, so learn your own spawn plus the two nearest hostile ones and clear those angles instead of sprinting into them. Live in interiors and on rooftops, never on Primorsky or Klimov Street, because the long lanes are where geared squads farm. The reliable grinders are the LexOs block, the Concordia courtyards and the Klimov mall atrium, and you should always carry a green RSP-30 so the Klimov Street extract stays open. Don't contest Kaban's dealership on a loot run — his snipers pin you while a third party rotates in — and in Season 1 expect roaming Black Division on top of both bosses.
notes: The most quest-dense map in the game: about 53 trader tasks reference it, 37 of them Streets-only. It is also the heaviest on your hardware — turn settings down before you blame your aim.

name: Terminal
size: Medium linear fortified port with container berths and a pier
players: 1–5 · in PvP, strangers are matched in even if you queue solo

bosses.name: One random boss per raid: Glukhar, Killa, Reshala, Sanitar or Tagilla
bosses.chance: Exactly one of the five spawns every raid, in the medium container-ship berths
bosses.threat: You cannot plan which one you get, and Glukhar, Reshala and Sanitar each arrive with three guards. Scout the berths before committing.

bosses.name: Black Division
bosses.chance: Always present as scripted assault squads
bosses.threat: They ambush you at the armoury exit, the seaport terminal building, the administration door and the SZ-1 charge spawns. Scripted, not a rare roam.

loot.name: The Armory
loot.yield: Your confiscated kit in a random locker. The Armory key is guaranteed on a dead RUAF soldier outside, and Black Division assault the west exit as you leave

loot.name: Seaport terminal building (MS)
loot.yield: The Black Division keycard in a 5×2 weapon box on a tipped-over ATM, guarded by a BD squad

loot.name: Administration building (D3)
loot.yield: A keycard-swipe service passage, with the hallway inside stocked with provisions and meds

loot.name: Pumping station and the container-ship berths
loot.yield: The Pier door key in a safe, guaranteed, plus the drain button. The berths are the boss spawn

keys.name: An access item — bring exactly one
keys.opens: Entry itself, at the port garrison intercom: Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint, an RFID keycard with unknown name from Lightkeeper, a reprogrammed RFID keycard with Prapor's hash codes, or Kerman's hash-code keycard plus the Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence

keys.name: Toolset — not a key, but non-negotiable
keys.opens: Guaranteed electrical-panel repair. Repairing bare-handed injures your arms. Solo repairs one panel, groups up to five

keys.name: "The Eye" mortar strike signaling device
keys.opens: Warns you when a mortar barrage is about to land on you

keys.name: Armory key, Black Division keycard, SZ-1 charge, Pier door key
keys.opens: The four in-raid objective locks. All spawn guaranteed in raid, cannot be discarded, and cannot go in a secure container — so don't try to bring them

tip: Terminal is not a loot raid, it is a 45-minute scripted assault where everyone spawns in one building — including strangers you got matched with while queuing solo — so your first real decision is cooperate or kill, because the Zubr never has enough seats for a four or five man and the pier timer is only three minutes. Bring a Toolset and "The Eye". Don't sprint the pier gate: the classic wipe is a squad reaching the boat together and then knifing each other over the last seat. And never re-raise your weapon after it auto-lowers near the transit zone — the garrison just deletes you.
notes: Entry is transit-only from Shoreline with no direct map selection: present an access item at the port garrison intercom on the watchtower. Your gear is restored on death or extract, minus the consumed access item — but not if you die on Shoreline en route. Seats: three or fewer players all get one, four get three to four, five get four to five. Zero trader side tasks — Terminal exists for the story chapter 'The Ticket'. In PvE it forces play on BSG servers.
pending: Wiki lists the entry window as 21:00–06:00 but a later patch widened it — current hours unverified

name: The Lab
size: Small, fully indoor multi-level TerraGroup facility (~0.09 km², unofficial)

bosses.name: Scav Raiders
bosses.chance: Always — there is no traditional boss
bosses.threat: The hardest AI in the game in the most enclosed space. They push with grenades and 7.62 rather than trading peeks.

bosses.name: Black Division and The Wedge
bosses.chance: Season 1 seasonal characters — they replace Raiders here entirely (not a rare roam)
bosses.threat: SR-25, M60E6 and SCAR-H kits with far more pocket space than Raiders. On seasonal characters the transit out is also disabled.

loot.name: Kruglov's office (R22) and the laboratory experiment's area (G12)
loot.yield: Black keycard rooms. The safe holds a guaranteed Cardinal apartment key every raid, plus Bitcoin, intel folders, Blue Folders, keycards and textbooks. G12 adds LEDX, a medcase and stims

loot.name: Security arsenal (Red keycard) and arsenal storage
loot.yield: MP5s and modded M4s including an M4A1 SOPMOD II, bulk ammo and mods, Bitcoin on the shelves

loot.name: Security post (Violet keycard)
loot.yield: UHF RFID Reader on the server rack, 3 weapon boxes, Blue Folders, cash, MP5SD or modded M4, Bitcoin, LEDX

loot.name: Medical block: quarantine zone (Blue G11), laboratory block (Green G22), Sanitar's room
loot.yield: Medcases, LEDX, stims and ophthalmoscopes, plus a Black keycard spawn in G22 and Red keycard spawns in G11 and the Yellow room

loot.name: The free-loot layer, no keycards needed
loot.yield: GPUs on the white tables right of the orange dome, LEDX on the barrels and by the forklift in the chemical spill dome, and a LEDX in the server room office (B12)

keys.name: TerraGroup Labs access keycard
keys.opens: Entry itself — consumed every raid, one per squad member. From Therapist or Ref LL3, an Intelligence Center craft, marked rooms, bosses or the Cultist Circle

keys.name: Labs keycard (Black)
keys.opens: Kruglov's office (R22) and its safe, plus the laboratory experiment's area (G12) — the highest-value rooms in the map

keys.name: Labs keycard (Violet)
keys.opens: The security post — UHF RFID Reader, 3 weapon boxes, Bitcoin, LEDX

keys.name: Labs keycard (Red)
keys.opens: The security arsenal — MP5s, modded M4s, SOPMOD II, ammo and mods, and the arsenal storage door

keys.name: Labs keycard (Green)
keys.opens: The laboratory block (G22) — 3 medcases, LEDX, and a Black keycard spawn

tip: Never insure anything you bring here — Labs returns nothing, ever, so every death is a total loss on top of a consumed keycard. Every extract except Ventilation Shaft, which allows no backpack, and Sewage Conduit, which needs the B1 water drained over about eighty seconds, fires a PA announcement naming your sector the instant you activate it. Flipping any extract switch can spawn Raiders who then walk straight at that switch, so activate late or just use the two silent ones. Fight from the long hallways and dome catwalks, and never loot a single-door keycard room while Raiders are still alive.
notes: The access keycard is consumed on entry, so treat every raid as an investment that needs a return.
upcoming: On Season 1 seasonal characters, Black Division and The Wedge replace Raiders and the transit out of The Lab is disabled. Permanent PvP and PvE profiles keep the normal Raider setup.

name: The Labyrinth
size: Small, fully indoor trap-laid bunker maze

bosses.name: Shadow of Tagilla
bosses.threat: One-shots with the Chained Labrys and lays the tripwires at raid start. Fight him down a corridor with a wall to break his charge.

bosses.name: Vengeful Killa
bosses.chance: Always, but only spawns after Shadow of Tagilla dies
bosses.threat: A harder Killa variant that appears the instant you win the first boss fight — usually while you are still looting.

loot.name: Prototype weapon area / "Item 1156" missile lab
loot.yield: The core objective zone, with multiple Labrys research notes spawns. Five are needed for Hypotheses Testing, and each crafts a fresh access keycard

loot.name: Observation room
loot.yield: More research notes plus the deceased scientist's audio tape. Small and fast, and the key is guaranteed in the hand of one of five lab technicians

loot.name: Corpse room
loot.yield: Quest-relevant loot. The key spawns guaranteed each raid across six possible spots, or drops from Shadow of Tagilla

loot.name: Boss bodies
loot.yield: The real payday: Tagilla's "ZABEY" mask, Tagilla-edition AVS carrier, Labrys research notes, a Labrys access keycard and the Ariadne symbol key, plus Killa's Maska helmet and face shield, 6B13 M and RPK-16. Scavs here are better equipped than normal and often carry xTG-12 injectors

keys.name: Labrys access keycard
keys.opens: Entry itself — mandatory, consumed on entry, one per player. Jaeger mails you two during the story chapter then offers a barter; also craftable from Labrys research notes at the Cultist Circle

keys.name: Knossos LLC facility key
keys.opens: The Shoreline health-resort west-wing basement door that leads to the Labyrinth transit

keys.name: Observation room key
keys.opens: The observation room. The only Labyrinth key that fits a secure container, so keep a spare between raids

keys.name: Corpse room key
keys.opens: The corpse room. Carryable but not secure-container eligible

keys.name: xTG-12 or Perfotoran — not a key, but non-negotiable
keys.opens: Counters the poisoned barbed wire, which ticks about 140 HP per minute

tip: Never insure anything you bring here — insurance returns nothing from the Labyrinth. First thing every raid, solve your spawn chamber's hazard before you think about loot: find Key 01-04, the BBQ-S43 gas torch or the valve handwheel and hit the button or lever, because panicking into the toxic pool, steam or shotgun trap is the number-one death. Walk, don't sprint — spike pits toggle each raid and the poisoned barbed wire rotates — and drifting into the centre trips an alarm that summons Shadow of Tagilla. Don't plan on Ariadne's Path, its key only drops in-raid; The Way Up opens at fifteen minutes with an audible door sound and is the honest exit.
notes: Entry is transit-only from Shoreline via the health resort west-wing basement: the door needs the Knossos LLC facility key and each player consumes a Labrys access keycard. It began as a March 2025 event map and was kept permanently after positive feedback. Six trader side tasks — one each from Therapist, Skier, Peacekeeper, Mechanic, Ragman and Lightkeeper — plus its own story chapter.

name: Icebreaker
size: Small footprint but strongly vertical — the nuclear icebreaker "Boreas", multiple decks
players: 1–3, AI only — no random players are ever matched in

bosses.name: The Wedge + 3–6 guards
bosses.chance: Always — fixed spawn on level 3, in the gym
bosses.threat: Black Division commander with an MP7 and up to six heavily armoured guards, in a gym with almost no cover.

bosses.name: Knight + 2 Rogue guards
bosses.threat: The Goons' leader appears solo here with Rogue escorts and a .50 AE Desert Eagle. Level 0 is tight and he pushes.

bosses.name: Rogues and Black Division
bosses.threat: Rogues and Black Division garrison the ship and scale with your squad size, so a trio faces meaningfully more guns than a solo. Not a rare roam.

loot.name: Compartments C-1 and C-3, keycard-locked cargo holds
loot.yield: The Boreas' classified cargo, and the C-1 hard drives that the Boreas questline turns in

loot.name: Boreas crew quarters
loot.yield: Keycard-locked living decks — personal valuables and gear

loot.name: Boreas engine room
loot.yield: Keycard-locked machinery spaces — technical and hideout materials, AMG-10 hydraulic fluid

loot.name: Bridge, upper decks and the boss bodies
loot.yield: The Wedge's LV-119 carrier, ComTac VI headset and MP7 parts; Knight's mask, Goons-edition CPC carrier and Desert Eagle L6

keys.name: Green flare (RSP-30 or 26×75 mm) + €2,400 per player
keys.opens: The Helicopter extract — the only way off the ship. Fire the flare high inside the signal area or the helicopter will not come

keys.name: Boreas crew quarters keycard
keys.opens: The crew living decks

keys.name: Boreas engine room keycard
keys.opens: The engine room machinery spaces

keys.name: Compartment C-1 and C-3 keycards
keys.opens: The two locked cargo compartments — the C-1 hard drives are a Boreas objective

keys.name: SZ-1 explosive charge / BBQ-S43 gas torch
keys.opens: Breaching charges and a cutting tool for sealed doors aboard

tip: Never insure anything you bring here — insurance returns nothing from Icebreaker, and entry costs 700,000 roubles on top. There are no random PMCs, so this is a scripted PvE clear: move deck by deck with your squad, use the stairwells as chokepoints, and let the scaling AI come to you rather than pushing the gym where The Wedge's six guards have every angle. Do not board without a green flare and €2,400 per player, because the helicopter is the only extract on the ship and a raid with no flare is a guaranteed fifty-minute loss.
notes: Added 25 May 2026 as the thirteenth location, alongside the 'Boreas' story chapter. Entry is initially transit-only from the Shoreline pier for 700,000 roubles after unlocking it in Boreas; direct selection unlocks on completing the Stick to It questline, and the fee still applies. Because no random players are matched in, it is the one large map you can learn without being hunted. In PvE it forces play on BSG servers.
